notes.title: Upcoming Easter Update
notes.notes:
Dear Shakes & Fidget Community, 

We would like to tell you more about the upcoming updates in Shakes & Fidget! Last year was great and we created many exciting new features, like the blacksmith, the new achievement system, and the Underworld. It won’t be an easy task, but the Shakes & Fidget team here at Playa Games is determined to do you one better this year – and it already starts with next week’s Easter update!
  
For the first time in the history of Shakes & Fidget, there will be a new class: the Assassin! The Assassin is a mix of Scout and Warrior, and the only class that can dual-wield weapons. 
We will also introduce a new dungeon with 20 levels: the Time-honored School of Magic. Any ideas what that might refer to and whom you’ll encounter there? 

There will also be a number of useful improvements. You can find out more about them soon in the official patch log! One feature that we initially planned to release is missing though: Last year in October, we announced that we are planning an update with a focus on guilds in the first quarter of 2018. Part of this guild update (the 100 new guild raids) has been live since December and we wanted to release the other part with the Easter update. However, it doesn’t quite work as intended, yet. So, instead of delaying the whole update, we will simply deliver the new guild feature once it’s ready in a few weeks. We also have big plans for after this update: You can expect the next surprise around Shakes & Fidget’s anniversary in June. We have been working on it for over a year now and it will be the biggest change the game has seen in three years! Are you curious, yet? 😊 

We wish you lots of fun, 
Your Shakes & Fidget team

notes.title: Pets update is coming soon!
notes.notes:
There will be 100 pets that can be divided into 5 classes/colors: 
Fire, water, earth, light and shadow - with 20 pets each. Each class consists of 14 common, 4 rare and 2 epic ones. With a bit of luck common pets can be found on quests in certain regions at a certain time of the day, for example in the Busted Lands at night. Rare and epic pets are more difficult to find, for example only during a specific weekend event.

All pets can be found in eggs whose colors show a pet's class. You can raise and level up a pet until level 100 by feeding them with fruits. 

It's not only about the pleasure of collecting the pets as they can also fight! You are matched against a random opponent and color and have to choose one of your colors to start the fight. You can use every color only once a day, which limits battles to five a day. Defeat another player's pets to win food and make your way to the top in the new Hall of Fame for pets! 

In addition, there will be 5 new dungeons (called "Habitats"), one for each pet color, which can be only visited by a pet of the same color. Complete one of this habitats to receive an epic pet!

All this information is subject to change during development.

notes.title: Pets update and Easter event
notes.notes:
We’re celebrating Easter with every special weekend event at once! This means that from March 25 to 28 you get more experience, more gold, more mushrooms, and more epic items (level 50 and up). And, above all, you get 20% more mushrooms with every purchase!

But that’s not everything, by a long shot! Shakes & Fidget unveiled the dark shadow world a few months ago. Now friendlier creatures will soon settle the land. This time you can collect, train and compete with them. The pets are coming!

The pets descend from the five elements of fire, water, earth, light, and shade. Tamed and trained by you, they can explore their own dungeons, pit their strength against others in battle, and improve your abilities. They’ll be here soon!

We wish you lots of fun,
Your Shakes & Fidget team
